title: scene.update (publisher → relay → viewers)
description: Incremental change of visual properties for 1..1000 nodes (docs/protocol.md §8.1). The relay enforces baseVersion == session.sceneVersion and sceneVersion > baseVersion (BAD_SEQUENCE otherwise) and rejects it while a snapshot is in flight (§6.2); the schema checks shapes and the 1000-change limit (§3.3).

sceneVersion.description: New scene version, greater than baseVersion (§8.1, §8.4).

baseVersion.description: Version the receiver must currently hold (§8.1).

changes.description: Per-node changes; unknown nodeIds are ignored by viewers (§8.1).
